async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Wait for the page to fully load after previous actions
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for dynamic content
    # Retrieve the text content of the main area where issues are listed

        issues_container = page.get_by_role('main')
        issues_text = await issues_container.inner_text()
    except:
        # Fall back to body text if main role not found
        issues_text = await page.inner_text('body')
    return issues_text
